specification.intent: Parse supported office/PDF/spreadsheet formats, persist document/chunk relations and expose authorized top-k retrieval with explicit readiness states.

requirements.title: Document ingestion and RAG
requirements.description: Consume the accepted file contract, parse docx/doc/PDF/xlsx with bounded failure behavior, embed chunks and expose admin ingestion plus authorized top-k retrieval.

specification.goal: A reviewed, deterministic implementation plan for stage 8.
constraints: Stage 6 file contract is the only file semantic source.
Admin-only ingestion and chat-scoped retrieval are server-side.
`.doc` conversion has a hard timeout and explicit failed state.
No OCR, cloud fallback or production deployment.

leadOwned.reason: The controller owns frozen plan-package artifacts retained in the implementation delta.
The controller maintains the repository progress log for this implementation package.

workstreams.title: Documents and RAG ingestion
workstreams.launchGate: Stages 5 and 6 are accepted in origin/dev at the exact declared base SHA (dev@ac50c6f6d7e7bac8a3af33aaa7aaa792aaca028a, which also carries the completed stage 2-4 and 7 frontend contour through PRs #17-#20); create feature/2026-09-28-backend-docs-rag from dev@ac50c6f6d7e7bac8a3af33aaa7aaa792aaca028a.
workstreams.qualityFloor: No failed or partial document is searchable as ready; every external parser/model failure is explicit.

criteria.title: Format ingestion
criteria.statement: Fixed docx, doc, text-PDF and xlsx fixtures reach deterministic ready/failed states, including bounded doc timeout/failure.
criteria.description: Parser behavior is deterministic and non-OCR.

criteria.title: Scoped retrieval
criteria.statement: Authorized top-k retrieval is chat-scoped, returns file_id metadata and excludes failed/partial documents.
criteria.description: RAG data scope is enforced server-side.

evidence.description: Parser fixtures, status transitions and bounded converter failure receipt.
Retrieval authorization, file_id traceability and RAG checklist receipt.

acceptance.releaseGate: Parser/unit evidence and scoped retrieval evidence are accepted; external dependencies are explicit.
acceptance.qualityFloor: No criterion is accepted from prose alone.

commands: (cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest tests/unit/ingestion tests/integration/rag)

releaseTarget.environment: local-only Docker Compose (plain postgres:16-alpine as shipped today) plus a native Ollama embedding endpoint and a bounded LibreOffice document converter; embeddings persist as portable JSON vectors

releaseImpact: Adds local document ingestion and chat-scoped retrieval; no cloud fallback or production readiness is claimed.

securityGates.statement: Only authorized admin flow can start ingestion.
Retrieval is membership/chat scoped and failed documents are excluded.

externalServices: postgresql (plain image; pgvector is a carry-forward)

runtimePolicy.unavailableDependencyPolicy: record UNAVAILABLE; never convert to PASS
preservationInvariants: course CI, netlify.toml, sprint_* and deploy remain unchanged
stage 6 file contract and central backend composition remain untouched

tierResolution.reason: architecture-risk, externalEnvironment-risk, performance-risk, security-risk and external-specification-required

taskTemplates.backend: small-context packet with parser/RAG files and backend verify

compatibility.fileContract: stage 6 accepted contract (File model, FileService, ObjectStorage seam)
compatibility.embeddingModel: configurable local provider; no cloud fallback
compatibility.endpointMounting: documents router registers through the stage-5 seam app.api.v1.router.register_domain_router, called from backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/__init__.py; main.py and router.py stay untouched
compatibility.embeddingStorage: chunks persist portable JSON float vectors and top-k cosine similarity runs in the service after a chat-scoped candidate query; pgvector-native storage/indexing is an explicit hardening carry-forward (deterministic sqlite test gate, compose ships plain postgres:16-alpine, course scale)
compatibility.parserDependencies: python-docx, pypdf and openpyxl are added to backend/pyproject.toml; httpx becomes a runtime dependency for the local Ollama embedding client
compatibility.docConverter: LibreOffice soffice subprocess behind a hard timeout with an injectable command seam; the deterministic tests inject a fake command, the live checklist row runs the host converter
compatibility.ragSettings: backend/app/ingestion/config.py reads env-driven settings with defaults (embedding url/model, converter command/timeout, top-k cap); backend/app/core/config.py is untouched
